source.citation: Coat, British, ca. 1833, silk (1981.210.4), and trousers, British, ca. 1833, flax (1982.316.11), shown together on a form with waistcoat and stock. The Metropolitan Museum of Art, The Costume Institute; open-access photograph DT412.
